cases.name: Amanda Hicks
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "A native Floridian, Amanda was born in Port St. Lucie, Florida, where she spent most of her life. She had lived for short periods of time in the Florida Keys and in Rotunda, Florida.

Amanda was a 6th grade English Language Arts teacher. She loved her students and helping them with success in learning to read. Amanda taught at Dr. David L. Anderson Middle School for the past 3 years. She had previously taught at Westgate K-8 in Port St. Lucie.

When not teaching, Amanda enjoyed painting, planting, going to the beach, and snorkeling. By far her greatest joy was her daughter and her family.

Amanda was a strong woman and a bright light, with a beautiful and giving spirit. She will be greatly missed by all whose lives she touched."
